description: Checks whether a person or firm is on SEBI's public registers of research analysts (RA) and investment advisers (IA), by registration number or by name. Returns each match with its registration number, type, the date its current registration began and its state, from SEBI's registers as read on 2026-11-28 (read monthly). Use it before the user pays for stock tips or advice. A name not found may be spelt differently or registered after that date; SEBI's own register is the final word.

query.description: A registration number (INH followed by 9 digits for an RA, INA followed by 9 digits for an IA) or the registered name, or part of it (3 to 100 characters)

name: sebi_registration_check
title: SEBI research analyst or investment adviser registration check
